layers.text: Style: chunky, friendly pixel art like a cosy toy box: a bright but not neon palette (warm tomato red, sky blue, sunny yellow, mint green, cream), soft two-tone shading, rounded cartoon shapes with a dark outline, big clear shapes and few details, readable at a glance at 50 px. Flat, straight-on view only: never isometric, never three-quarter, no perspective.

Class (parts icons): one electronic part drawn as a chunky toy sticker icon, straight-on flat 2D view, centred, filling most of the canvas. Big clear shapes, dark outline, two-tone shading lit from straight above, transparent background with nothing around the part.

Subject: an electrolytic capacitor standing upright: a chunky rounded cylinder can in sky blue with a cream stripe down one side and a slightly domed silver top, two short straight silver wire legs coming out of the bottom. Straight front view, symmetric, centred.
